title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Commitment on Crew Arrival: Late-Arrival Credits
content:
Northgate credits a late crew on a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment.

## When a crew is late

A crew arrival counts as late only when the minutes late exceed the service level's grace minutes. The minutes late are the minutes from the end time of the booked arrival window to the crew's logged arrival time on the appointment's most recent attempt, and they are 0 when the crew arrived before the end of the window.

## What a late arrival earns

1. A late arrival earns the service level's late-arrival credit, applied to the appointment's charge of the type the service level names for that credit.
2. The credit is never more than that charge's net amount: the charge's amount less every credit already posted against that charge.
3. A service level whose credit is zero, or an appointment with no such charge, earns nothing.
4. A delivery credit is posted only on an appointment whose status is completed, attempt failed or cancelled; nothing is credited while the delivery is still scheduled or under way.
5. An appointment earns at most one late-arrival credit, and a late attempt that then failed for one of the service level's member-caused reasons earns none.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures: window ending 12:00, grace 15 minutes, credit $25.00)

| Logged arrival | Minutes late | Late? | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11:40 | 0 | No | None |
| 12:15 | 15 | No (15 does not exceed 15) | None |
| 12:16 | 16 | Yes | $25.00, capped at the charge's net amount |

| Charge credited | Amount | Credits already against it | Net | Late-arrival credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hypothetical charge A | $89.00 | none | $89.00 | $25.00 |
| Hypothetical charge B | $30.00 | $10.00 | $20.00 | $20.00 |

An appointment that already carries a late-arrival credit earns no second one. An appointment whose late attempt then failed with a member-caused reason earns none.
